name: BcDevEnv Test Runner
brief: OData test-runner endpoint for bcdevenv run-tests.
description: Exposes a 'BcDevEnvTestRunner' web service for 'bcdevenv run-tests'. RunAll runs the installed test codeunits via the Microsoft test framework toolkit; the per-codeunit protocol (PrepareTests, RunCodeunit, GetCodeunitResults) prepares a suite for one extension/test type/isolation, excludes the DisabledTests entries before execution and runs one codeunit per call. Results are returned as xUnit XML, which 'bcdevenv run-tests' converts to JUnit. With the altool executor, the 'BcDevEnv Reset ...' test codeunits run before every test codeunit to reset the test state that carries over from one test codeunit to the next (the 'Application Area Setup' table, restored to its baseline and committed, test initialization, the permissions mock, the D365 Full Access permission base for codeunits whose TestPermissions is not Disabled, and the last error); GetStateResetSummary reports what they did. From PrepareTests until EndTestRun, every client session that opens a company (the AL tool logs in once per invocation) gets ApplicationArea(''), as the Test Runner does before every test method; the 'Application Area Setup' table is not changed. When Application Test Library and Permissions Mock are installed, a test method whose Initialize raises OnTestInitialize of 'Library - Test Initialize' gets the last error cleared and, when the permissions mock is stopped, the mock restarted with its codeunit's base, as the Test Runner does before every test method. With --state-probe on, the diagnostic 'BcDevEnv State Probe' test codeunit runs first in every batch and reports the state in its error message.
